findings.issue: Pinned beta of Nitro 3 (3.0.260610-beta, June 2026); Nitro v3 reached RC on 2026-10-29 and the RC notes list breaking changes for beta users.
findings.suggestion: Upgrade the pin to the v3.0.261029-rc (or the first stable v3 when it lands) after running the acceptance tests, and keep the exact-pin style until v3 goes stable.

findings.issue: The only beta-channel integration (nitro()) carries implicit risk of breaking build output between betas.
findings.suggestion: Keep it isolated here; when nitro-specific options are needed (preset, prerender), pass them via the documented top-level nitro config rather than reaching into nitro runtime APIs.

findings.issue: @solidjs/start 2.1.0 was published 2026-10-22, eight days before review day, so the app rides the newest stable patch line.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable since 2.1.0 is stable, but pin a known-good minor in CI and note that new minor APIs (e.g. ssr: "data-only") are deliberately unused.

summary: This is a deliberately conservative SolidStart v2 app: no experimental flags or unstable API names, and application code uses only long-stable, idiomatic patterns (query + "use server" inside the query body, createAsync, FileRoutes, standard entries). The single beta-channel dependency, nitro v3 beta, is the deployment plugin SolidStart v2's own stable docs prescribe and is confined to one line in vite.config.ts with an exact version pin. Residual risk is upstream beta-to-RC churn, which a pinned upgrade addresses.
